description: Web POS sale + web payment flow + POS print path in src/screens/web/WebPOSScreen.tsx (design §5.3 entirely, §7 POS sale/Payment web parts, design-review NITs 1-3). Single large file (~4078 lines). Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. Plan item 4.
steps: Wire printing: printReceipt80mm (~:383) keeps its signature/callers but builds data with buildPosReceiptData(invoice, billType, cfg, { shopBranch: SHOP_BRANCH, ...existing fallbacks }) from src/utils/posReceiptData.ts, then buildTemplateHtml and window.open as today. Invoice interface (~:50) gains issuedAt?: number and payMethods?: {id: string; label?: string}[].

Producers: new-sale invoice (~:2704-2713) adds issuedAt: now.getTime(), payMethods: splitPayments.map(sp => ({ id: sp.method, label: sp.label })), cashier: currentUser?.name ?? '' (billNo keeps BE year), legacy payMethod string = splitPayments.map(sp => payMethodLabel(sp.method, 'th', sp.label)).join(' + '); invoicesFromHistory (~:1608) adds issuedAt: d.getTime(), payMethods: sale.payments.map(p => ({ id: p.method })), payMethod (~:1619) -> sale.payments.map(p => payMethodLabel(p.method, 'th')).join(' + '); voidNote (~:1685) adds issuedAt: Date.now(), payMethods: cancelTarget.payMethods; fullTaxInv (~:3097) adds issuedAt: now.getTime(), payMethods: selectedInv.payMethods; MOCK_INVOICES (~:69-112) get payMethods ids (cash/qr/transfer) and no issuedAt.

Pay types: PaymentType (~:47) -> { id; label?: string; icon; color }; DEFAULT_PAY_TYPES (~:120-125) drop built-in labels; splitPayments state (~:1532) -> { method: string; label?: string; amount: number }[]; add-split (~:2663) stores payTypes.find(...)?.label. NO direct label reads anywhere: use payMethodLabel(id, 'th', label) for the legacy payMethod string, the logAction detail (~:2771, logAction sentence stays Thai) and broadcastDisplay({ payMethodLabel }) (~:2489, customer display stays Thai — do not touch customerDisplayStore); use payMethodLabel(id, uiLang, label) for pay buttons, split list (~:2610), amount caption (~:2648), PaymentSettingsModal list (~:341; rename the map var `t` -> `pt`). Add local helper invPayLabel(inv, uiLang) = inv.payMethods ? inv.payMethods.map(m => payMethodLabel(m.id, uiLang, m.label)).join(' + ') : inv.payMethod, used at the invoice list column (~:2073), invoice search (~:1646, also matching inv.payMethod) and invoice-detail badge (~:3045). Invoice-list icon (~:2068-2071) -> PAY_ICON[inv.payMethods?.[0]?.id ?? ''] ?? 'card-outline'.

Payment/member labels: summary row (~:2395) memberTypeDiscountLabel(memberType, uiLang); pass lang: uiLang into buildCalculationArgs/runCartPromotions calls and add uiLang to their memo deps; on-screen cashier fallback (~:1299) -> t('pos.cashierFallback').

Translate the whole file's UI chrome via useT()/useFormat(): sale panel, cart (cart-row sub-component calls useT itself), cashier label, member badge, order types via ORDER_TYPE_KEYS (ปกติ/สั่งจอง/เดลิเวอรี/ทานที่ร้าน), buttons, modals, confirm/alert, toasts, empty states, hold bills, invoice list tabs/filters, bill-type selector, payment modal (methods, split, PromptPay QR, auto-confirm, received/change, points, coupons, applied promotions labels), PaymentSettingsModal. Replace the local money/date `fmt` and toLocaleString usages with useFormat(). Keep logAction strings, mock product/member/shop data and SHOP_* constants as data.

Paper mocks (receipt / abbreviated tax / full tax iv.rc* components) use useReceiptT(): cancelled stamps (~:789/:851/:956) rt('receipt.cancelledStamp'); captions เลขที่/วันที่/แคชเชียร์/ชำระด้วย/เลขที่ใบกำกับภาษี/วันที่ออก/โทร/เลขประจำตัวผู้เสียภาษี… via rt('receipt.*'); date values (~:795/:856) invoice.issuedAt ? receiptDateTime(invoice.issuedAt, rl) : rt('receipt.dateTimeValue', {date, time}); full-tax issue date (~:1003) fmt.date(issuedAt) else invoice.date; pay rows (~:797/:858/:1005) invoice.payMethods ? receiptPayMethod(invoice.payMethods, rl) : invoice.payMethod; thank-you footer rt('receipt.thankYou'); {SHOP_BRANCH} -> receiptBranch(SHOP_BRANCH, rl). Wallet top-up slip HTML (~:3403-3420) via translate(rl, 'receipt.*') + formatMoney(…, rl). Never call t() with receipt.* (compile error by design).

Add keys to src/i18n/locales/th/{pos,payment,receipt,receiptScreen,common}.ts + en counterparts with natural POS English (Hold bill, Charge, Split payment, Change, Points, Coupon, Dine-in, Delivery, Pre-order, Walk-in/Regular, etc.).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` still 13 baseline errors, 0 in WebPOSScreen.tsx
`npm test` green vs baseline (posReceiptData parity still passes)
Remaining Thai literals in WebPOSScreen.tsx are only comments, logAction strings, mock data (MOCK_INVOICES/products/members/shop constants) — list the categories in findings
No `.label` read of PaymentType/splitPayments outside payMethodLabel calls
Forbidden files untouched; imports of useCustomerDisplayStore/WebCustomerDisplayScreen unchanged
verification: git -C d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\i18n diff --name-only HEAD  (WebPOSScreen.tsx + i18n locale files only)
findings:
Commit c12fa03. Verification: lint = 13 baseline errors (0 in WebPOSScreen.tsx / locale files); npm test = 301 pass + the 3 known suite-load failures (posReceiptData parity + locale parity pass); diff = WebPOSScreen.tsx + 6 locale files only; no forbidden file touched; useCustomerDisplayStore/WebCustomerDisplayScreen imports unchanged; broadcastDisplay gets payMethodLabel(id,'th',label).
DONE: printReceipt80mm takes PosPrintInvoice and calls buildPosReceiptData(...SHOP_* fallbacks) + buildTemplateHtml(cfg.template). Invoice gains issuedAt/payMethods; producers set them (new sale: issuedAt, payMethods, cashier=currentUser?.name ?? '', legacy payMethod via payMethodLabel(...,'th'); invoicesFromHistory; voidNote; fullTaxInv; MOCK_INVOICES payMethods only). PaymentType.label optional, DEFAULT_PAY_TYPES unlabelled, splitPayments label optional; every display read goes through payMethodLabel (th for legacy string/logAction/customer display, uiLang for pay buttons, split list, amount caption, PaymentSettingsModal (map var t->pt)). Local invPayLabel(inv, uiLang) used in invoice list column, search (+inv.payMethod fallback) and detail pay badge; list icon via PAY_ICON. memberTypeDiscountLabel(memberType, uiLang). Paper mocks (receipt/tax_short/tax_full) via useReceiptT (captions, stamps, dates via receiptDateTime/dateTimeValue, pay rows via receiptPayMethod, branch via receiptBranch, thank-you); buyer-branch default = rt('receipt.headOffice'). Wallet top-up slip HTML via translate(receiptLanguage) + formatMoney + receiptDateTime. Local fmt replaced by useMoneyFmt()/useFormat()/useReceiptT().fmt; on-screen toLocaleString replaced by f.number/f.date/f.dateTime.
NOT APPLICABLE in WebPOSScreen: no runCartPromotions/buildCalculationArgs call (lang: uiLang only applies to PaymentScreen in FEAT-005), no order-type selector (ORDER_TYPE_KEYS not used), no PromptPay QR / auto-confirm / applied-promotion list in this file.
NEW KEYS: pos.{tabSale,tabInvoices,searchPlaceholder,allCategories,noProducts,outBadge,pieces,outOfStockFlash, inv.*(tabIssued,tabAttach,printBill,taxFullShort,taxFullForm,noPosRegNo,issueFullTax,fullTaxIssued,cancelFullTax,attachTitle,attachBtn,attachEmpty,attachHint,fileN,print,issuedRef,editBuyerShort,cancelFullTaxShort,cancelBill,tapToClose), fullTax.*, topup.*, cash.*, pin.*, shift.*, hold.*, invList.*, cart.*, member.*, disc.*, points.*, display.*, invDetail.*, voidBill.*, uom.*, variant.*}; payment.{couponInvalid,title,confirmPrint,amountDue,removeSplit,paidSoFar,remaining,chooseMethod,addMethod,amountFor,amountPlaceholder,fullAmount,walletBalance,change,walletNeedMember,walletInsufficient, settings.{title,subtitle,defaultTag,newPlaceholder,add}}; receipt.{discountExVat,taxBase,vatFull,vatFromBase,totalInclVatRate, topup.{title,member,memberNo,amount,balance}}.
THAI INTENTIONALLY LEFT in WebPOSScreen.tsx (all non-comment hits are these categories): (1) logAction titles/sentences (incl. their toLocaleString amounts); (2) mock data: MOCK_INVOICES (cashier names, item names, legacy payMethod strings, cancelReason, BE dates), CATS category names (CATS[0] 'ทั้งหมด' is the all-sentinel; rendered via t('pos.allCategories')); (3) SHOP_NAME/SHOP_ADDR/SHOP_BRANCH constants (shop data; SHOP_BRANCH translated on paper via receiptBranch); (4) persisted/actor data strings: walletPay/earnPoints/redeemPoints actor 'แคชเชียร์', cash-movement fallback reason 'นำเงินเข้า/นำเงินออก', holdBill remark 'เติมเงิน Wallet', auto cancelReason 'ยกเลิกเพื่อออกใบกำกับภาษีใหม่'; sale-history/shift cashierName fallback uses translate('th','pos.cashierFallback') so stored data stays Thai; (5) comments. Store-provided Thai shown as-is (out of scope): POS_ACTION_LABELS, PIN result.message, validateCoupon result.error, wallet tx.description. Bill numbers keep BE year (identifier).
NOTES: invoice list/detail header dates use UI-format (f.date/f.time) when issuedAt exists. Runtime window.open print paths not exercised in a browser (type-checked only).
